item.title: Transparency data: Premises contracted and built, Project Gigabit contracts
item.description: Building Digital UK (BDUK) reports on premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts.

item.title: Project Gigabit network build contract - New Forest
item.description: BDUK has awarded broadband provider Wessex Internet a Project Gigabit contract to provide around 10,500 premises across the New Forest and surrounding areas with access to gigabit-capable broadband.

item.title: Project Gigabit network build contract - Cambridgeshire
item.description: BDUK has awarded broadband provider CityFibre a Project Gigabit contract to provide up to 45,000 premises in Cambridgeshire with access to gigabit-capable broadband.

item.title: Project Gigabit network build contract - Teesdale
item.description: BDUK has awarded Borderlink, the parent company of GoFibre, a Project Gigabit contract to provide over 4,000 premises in Teesdale with access to gigabit-capable broadband.

item.title: Project Gigabit network build contract - North Dorset
item.description: BDUK has awarded Wessex Internet a Project Gigabit contract to provide over 7,000 premises in North Dorset with access to gigabit-capable broadband.
